name: param-uq-04-deep-params
title: Deep physiological parameters — sensitivity to sim_data attributes via ParCa-level injection.
claim:
(planned) Deep sim_data physiological parameters (transcription fractions,
metabolism kinetics, mass fractions) drive substantial growth/mass variance,
but accessing them requires ParCa-level injection beyond the config_overrides
path used in studies 00–02.
question:
How sensitive are growth/mass observables to the DEEP physiological sim_data
parameters (e.g., transcription rnap active fractions, metabolism
kinetic_objective_weight / secretion_penalty_coeff, mass cell_dry_mass_fraction)
that the uqEcoli demo varies — and which dominate?

report.title: param-uq-04-deep-params — sensitivity to sim_data physiological parameters
report.objective:
Extend the UQ coverage from config-reachable process-config scalars (studies
00–02) to the deeper physiological parameters embedded in the SimulationDataEcoli
dataclass. These parameters set fundamental biological rates (RNAP activity,
metabolic objectives, cell composition) and are the primary targets of the
original uqEcoli parameter uncertainty analysis. This study determines which
of these deep params most drive single-cell growth/mass variance.
report.setup:
Candidate parameters and bounds (matching the uqEcoli demo):

| Parameter | sim_data path | Low | High | Units | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| rnap_free | transcription.rnap_active_fraction | 0.25 | 0.47 | fraction | Fraction of RNAP not actively transcribing |
| rnap_bound | transcription.rnap_bound_fraction | 0.12 | 0.22 | fraction | Fraction of RNAP actively transcribing |
| basal_elongation_rate | transcription.basal_elongation_rate | 15 | 28 | aa/s | (sim_data copy — distinct from process-config) |
| kinetic_objective_weight | metabolism.kinetic_objective_weight | 5e-8 | 5e-7 | — | FBA kinetic objective weight |
| secretion_penalty_coeff | metabolism.secretion_penalty_coeff | 5e-4 | 5e-3 | — | FBA secretion penalty |
| dry_mass_frac | mass.cell_dry_mass_fraction | 0.25 | 0.35 | fraction | Dry-to-wet mass ratio |

Injection method: sim_data-level mutation via `sim_data_setattr` (uqEcoli
pattern) — NOT config_overrides. Each sample requires a per-sample ParCa
cache rebuild, which is substantially more expensive than the config-override
path used in studies 00–02.

This injection path is currently OUT OF REACH of the pbg-uq package and the
`baseline()` config_overrides interface. An infrastructure prerequisite is
implementing or adapting the uqEcoli-style sim_data injection in pbg-uq.

model_settings.name: sim-data-injection-required
model_settings.detail: Deep params require sim_data-level mutation (sim_data_setattr) + per-sample ParCa cache rebuild. Not reachable via config_overrides.

model_settings.name: parca-rebuild-cost
model_settings.detail: Each sample's parameter perturbation requires a fresh ParCa cache build (~2.5 min on mini). Budget must account for n×2.5 min overhead.

model_settings.name: pbg-uq-extension-needed
model_settings.detail: pbg-uq currently supports config_overrides injection only. A sim_data injection adapter must be implemented before this study can run.

assumptions.text:
The uqEcoli parameter bounds (RNAP fractions, FBA weights, mass fraction) are
meaningful uncertainty ranges for v2ecoli. They may need re-calibration if
v2ecoli's ParCa pipeline has shifted the baseline physiological state since
the original uqEcoli work.

Per-sample ParCa cache rebuilds are feasible within the available compute
budget (~2.5 min/rebuild on the Mac mini). A budget of n=30 train + 10 test
samples implies ~100 min of ParCa rebuild time in addition to simulation time.

tests.name: deep-param-injection-feasible-and-ranked
tests.question:
Can the deep sim_data parameters be injected cleanly (ParCa rebuild per sample,
no simulation crashes), and does a single parameter robustly dominate total-order
Sobol across growth/mass observables?

measure.detail:
PLANNED metric — (1) crash-free completion rate across all samples and (2) max
total-order Sobol across the 6 candidate deep params; a parameter is dominant if
its total-order Sobol ≥ 0.5. Not yet computed (study planned).

tests.cites_note: Sobol >= 0.5 dominance threshold is methodological; not literature-derived.

study_card.goal:
(planned) Extend UQ coverage from config-reachable process-config scalars
(studies 00–02) to the deeper physiological parameters in SimulationDataEcoli
(RNAP fractions, FBA weights, mass fractions) via sim_data-level injection, and
determine which most drive single-cell growth/mass variance.
study_card.why_before_next:
These deep params set fundamental biological rates and are the primary targets of
the original uqEcoli analysis; reaching them requires an injection path beyond
config_overrides, making this the infrastructure-gated frontier of the program.

biological_summary:
(planned) The deepest levers on growth/mass — RNAP active/bound fractions
(transcription capacity), FBA kinetic-objective and secretion-penalty weights
(metabolic flux allocation), and the dry-mass fraction (biomass accounting) — live
in the sim_data dataclass, not in process configs. This study would quantify their
sensitivity, requiring a per-sample ParCa cache rebuild to propagate each perturbation.

literature_anchors.expectation:
The candidate deep-parameter ranges (RNAP fractions, FBA weights, dry-mass
fraction) match the original uqEcoli analysis and the v2ecoli/wcEcoli sim_data parameterization.
literature_anchors.source: v2ecoli baseline parameterization (Macklin et al. 2020); uqEcoli demo bounds
literature_anchors.status_in_workspace: Planned — bounds adopted from uqEcoli; may need re-calibration to v2ecoli's current ParCa state.

model_change.notes:
(planned) No biological model change. Infrastructure work: a sim_data injection
adapter (sim_data_setattr) in pbg-uq plus a per-sample ParCa cache rebuild — not
reachable via the config_overrides path used in studies 00–02.

implementation_requirements.title: sim_data-level injection adapter in pbg-uq
implementation_requirements.description:
Add uqEcoli-style sim_data_setattr injection to pbg-uq (it currently supports only
config_overrides). Each perturbed sample mutates the SimulationDataEcoli dataclass.

implementation_requirements.title: Per-sample ParCa cache rebuild
implementation_requirements.description:
Each deep-param perturbation needs a fresh ParCa cache build (~2.5 min/sample on
the mini). Budget must account for ~n × 2.5 min of rebuild time.

design_pivot_required.question: Can the deep physiological params be reached via the baseline() config_overrides path?
design_pivot_required.decision:
NO. They live in SimulationDataEcoli and require sim_data-level mutation plus a
per-sample ParCa rebuild — out of reach of config_overrides. This study is gated on
a new pbg-uq injection adapter (see implementation_requirements).
alternatives: Approximate deep params with config-reachable proxies (rejected — not equivalent).

conclusion_verdicts.claim: (planned) A single deep sim_data parameter dominates growth/mass variance (total-order Sobol ≥ 0.5).
conclusion_verdicts.basis: Study not yet run — blocked on the pbg-uq sim_data injection adapter and ParCa-rebuild budget.
